# Recycled Christmas

> An annual one-day resale of gently used Christmas decorations held each November at First United Methodist Church of Arlington Heights, Illinois. It is a volunteer-run fundraiser of United Women in Faith. Free admission and parking, cash only.

## Key facts

- Event name: Recycled Christmas
- 2026 date: Saturday, November 14, 2026, 9:00 am-4:00 pm
- Location: First United Methodist Church of Arlington Heights, 1903 E Euclid Ave, Arlington Heights, IL 60004, United States
- Admission: free. Parking: free, on site.
- Payment accepted: cash only. No credit cards, no debit cards, no mobile payment, no ATM on site.
- Strollers are not permitted. The building is wheelchair accessible.
- A bake sale operates alongside the main sale.
- Merchandise: gently used artificial Christmas trees, wreaths, garland, ornaments, lights, nativity sets, Christmas village pieces, holiday dishes, mugs, serveware, tablecloths, linens, stockings, candles, cookie tins, baskets, gift wrap, greeting cards, Christmas books, outdoor decorations, ugly Christmas sweaters, handmade crafts.
- Beneficiary: United Women in Faith, funding programs for women, children and youth locally and internationally.
- Companion event: the same group runs a rummage sale each spring at the same church.
- Serves Arlington Heights and the northwest suburbs of Chicago, including Mount Prospect, Palatine, Buffalo Grove, Prospect Heights, Rolling Meadows and Wheeling.
